BT1643.theorem: The 2-skeleton of the W(3,3) line complex is a genus-21 surface and the CSS code is a topological quantum code on this surface
BT1643.code_distance_meaning: d = mu = 4 = minimum non-contractible cycle on genus-21 surface
BT1643.topological_code_type: Qutrit toric code analog on genus-21 surface (vs genus-1 for Kitaev toric code)
BT1643.boundary_theorem: The genus-21 surface is the boundary of the CSS code complex
